agents.role: Runs the shift board: which routes are staffed and which run short today, so a school that opens with no coverage is known at 6 AM, not at 8:15.
Keeps the substitute coverage and duty record as it happens: who was assigned, whether the assignment was filled, and what the classroom actually covered.
Watches the compliance clock for each filing, certification, and report the school owes, so a window closing is a reminder three days before it is a violation.

The only agent in this pack that may post across worlds. Publishes school operating status as counts (open, short-staffed, closed by weather), and receives building and transport status that affects the school day.

alerts.carries: The school id and the assignment id still unfilled, with minutes until the period starts. Local to the school; the chapter lead and admin act on it.
The teacher id (local only), the certification type, and the days remaining until it lapses. Local only.
The school id, the filing id, and the days left in the window. Local only.
The school id and the covered versus uncovered periods for the day as counts. Local only.
A summary only: school id, operating state (open, short-staffed, closed), and head counts by building. No staff names, no student data of any kind.

receives.carries: Transport service state affecting student arrival: reroutes and delays as states and counts, never incident details.
Storm clearing status by sector affecting school opening decisions, as counts and states.
Water advisory state affecting building operations (boil notices, pressure events), as states. No infrastructure record details.

sends.carries: School operating status as counts: open, short-staffed, closed, head counts by building. Never carries staff or student information.
never_carries: student names or any student data

firstboot.label: Staff roster: teachers and their assignments for this building
Minutes before a period an unfilled assignment must be flagged
Chapter leader or union rep contact for this installation
School admin contact for this installation

bus_summary: School operating states as counts (open, short-staffed, closed)
Head counts by building during disruptions
local_only: Teacher and staff names, assignments, and personnel records
Anything that identifies a student, including names, grades, or assessments

summary: Public school operations pack: watches staff coverage on today's shifts, substitute assignment fill state, certification and filing windows, and keeps the duty record. Built around the teaching crew: a school that opens short-staffed is known at 6 AM, certifications are reminded before they lapse, and the duty record is sealed honestly. Student data never leaves the building in any form. SPEC ONLY: this is a pack definition, not a running school system.

urgency.meaning: A building emergency affecting students or staff. Preempts everything else on the bus.
Unfilled assignments near period start, certifications about to lapse, coverage shortfalls on the day.
Filing windows closing and roster state changes.
Sealed duty record and end-of-day shift summary.

inputs: the staff roster from firstboot config
watchers.watches: Today's staffing: which classroom and school duty posts are staffed, which run short, and how many periods each shortfall touches.
Substitute assignment fill: every unfilled assignment with its countdown to period start, and every assignment offered but not accepted.

inputs: the certification and filing calendar for the building
state filing requirements configured at firstboot
watchers.watches: The compliance clock: certification expiry per staff member and filing or report windows per building, with reminders before each window closes.

inputs: scribe entries from the school day
watchers.watches: The verified duty record: assignments offered, filled, and refused per period per day, sealed at day end.
